review_candidates.title: Project Manager
review_candidates.description: Project Manager 📍 Location: Petaling Jaya (PJ), on-site 💰 Salary: RM 5,000 – RM 8,000/month (Based on experience) 🎯 Employment Type: Full-Time (Permanent) The Project Manager will lead the conceptualisation, development and launch of new HR-related projects and national-level initiatives, including talent management programmes, coaching and mentoring programmes, digital learning solutions and other workforce development projects. The role is responsible for conducting feasibility assessments, developing project plans and commercial models, securing strategic partners, coordinating stakeholders and service providers, managing budgets and timelines, and ensuring the successful implementation and sustainability of each project. The Project Manager acts as the bridge between strategic intent and operational delivery — translating the organisation's national HR agenda into well-scoped, commercially sound, and sustainably run programmes that create measurable value for members and the broader HR community. Key Responsibilities 1. Project Conceptualisation & Feasibility •     Identify and evaluate opportunities for new HR-related projects and national-level initiatives aligned with the organisation's strategic priorities. •     Conduct feasibility studies, market scans and needs assessments to validate the relevance, demand and viability of proposed projects. •     Develop business cases, including objectives, target outcomes, resourcing needs and risk assessments, for review by leadership. 2. Project Planning & Commercial Development •     Develop detailed project plans, including scope, deliverables, milestones, timelines and resource requirements. •     Design commercial and pricing models (e.g. fee-for-service, sponsorship, cost-sharing) that ensure each project is financially sustainable. •     Establish success metrics and KPIs for each project in consultation with leadership and relevant stakeholders. 3. Partner & Stakeholder Management •     Identify, evaluate and secure strategic partners, service providers, trainers, consultants and vendors required for project delivery. •     Negotiate partnership terms, contracts and service-level agreements, ensuring alignment with organisational standards and objectives. •     Coordinate and maintain strong working relationships with internal departments (e.g. marketing, business development, finance) and external stakeholders (e.g. government agencies, employers, professional bodies, member organisations). 4. Implementation & Delivery Management •     Lead end-to-end project execution, ensuring deliverables are completed on time, within budget and to the required quality standards. •     Manage project risks and issues proactively, escalating and resolving roadblocks in a timely manner. •     Coordinate logistics, communications and reporting across all project workstreams and involved parties. 5. Budget & Financial Management •     Prepare and manage project budgets, tracking expenditure against plan and reporting variances. •     Monitor project revenue (where applicable) against commercial targets and recommend corrective actions where needed. 6. Sustainability & Continuous Improvement •     Ensure each project has a clear plan for long-term sustainability beyond initial launch, including handover to business-as-usual operations where relevant. •     Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement in future projects. •     Keep abreast of trends and developments in HR, talent management and learning & development (L&D) to inform future project pipelines. 7. Reporting & Governance •     Provide regular project status updates, dashboards and reports to leadership and relevant committees. •     Ensure all projects comply with the organisation's governance, procurement and risk-management policies. Requirements Education •     Bachelor's degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Organisational Development or a related field. •     A relevant postgraduate qualification or professional HR certification (e.g. IHRP, CIPD, SHRM) is an added advantage. Experience •     Minimum 5-8 years of relevant working experience, with a strong background in Human Resources and demonstrated exposure to Learning & Development (L&D). •     Proven experience managing projects or programmes from concept through to launch and sustained delivery, ideally involving talent management, coaching/mentoring, digital learning or professional development initiatives. •     Experience developing commercial or revenue models for programmes, and working with external partners, vendors or service providers. •     Experience engaging senior stakeholders, including employers, government bodies, professional associations or industry partners, is highly desirable. Skills & Competencies •      Project Management — strong command of project management methodologies, tools and best practices, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects. •      Commercial Acumen — able to design and evaluate sustainable, revenue-generating or cost-effective programme models. •      Stakeholder Management & Negotiation — skilled at building relationships and negotiating win-win outcomes with partners, vendors and senior stakeholders. •      Communication & Presentation — excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to senior leadership and external parties. •      Analytical & Problem-Solving — able to conduct feasibility assessments, interpret data and make sound, evidence-based recommendations. •      Budgeting & Financial Management — comfortable developing and managing budgets and tracking financial performance. •      Adaptability & Initiative — self-driven and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with evolving priorities. •      Collaboration — works effectively across departments and with external partners to deliver shared goals. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

review_candidates.description: Job Description Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular. With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, space consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, flight test services, satellite propulsion systems, and much more. SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future. Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help earth benefit from space? If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact. We are looking for a dedicated professional who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage. Essential Job Requirements Proven experience in defining and implementing Operational Concepts for large systems. Strong background in the procurement, integration, and operations of Ground Segments. System engineering expertise, preferably in SATCOMs. Ability to manage complex requirements, including breakdown, tracing across different levels, and change management. Experience in managing industrial activities, including contract negotiations and conducting technical reviews. Desirable Experience in risk management and schedule tracking for large scale projects. Understanding of space and ground segments, including their respective subsystems. Familiarity with training schemes and methods relevant to operations engineering. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate and mitigate risks. Legal And Security Requirements Only European Union (EU) citizens can be employed by SSC Space Netherlands for this specific position. Applicants are required to provide a copy of their passport and degree certificate. SSC Space Netherlands will validate the Degree with the issuing University and provide evidence to ESA. In line with ESA’s security requirements, prior to issuing a letter of employment the applicant shall provide to SSC Space Netherlands a recent official document declaring that they are of good conduct from the country where currently resident, and SSC Space Netherlands will validate your employment history. Job Responsibilities Operational Concept Development: Define, develop, and validate the Operational Concept for the Ground Control Segment. Maintain alignment of the Constellation Operational Concept (CONOPS) with the ground segment throughout development, integration, and deployment. Ensure compliance of the S3C’s building blocks (e.g., simulators, mission planning system, flight dynamics system, platforms M&C) with the Operational Concept and system requirements. Support risk management by assessing vulnerabilities and implementing mitigation measures. Industry And Stakeholder Coordination Liaise with industry on technical requirements lifecycle, ensuring alignment with functional, performance, operational, service, and security needs. Collaborate with ESA’s Ground Segment System Engineers, Mission Ground Segment Engineers, Secure Connectivity Security Office (CSC-IX), and the industrial consortium designing and validating the S3C infrastructure. Ensure the TT&C distribution system to remote sites aligns with operational objectives. Technical Oversight & Compliance Monitor relevant schedules and proactively identify risks in the ground segment. Provide risk assessments and propose mitigation actions from both industry and ESA perspectives. Ensure end-to-end technical consistency across all procurement activities at the S3C level. Support security engineering activities in coordination with the Security Office. Job Benefits The selected candidate will receive a competitive remuneration. When autonomous then teleworking can often be utilised. Will be registered for both social security and tax in the Netherlands. The standard working hours are 40 per week. There are 12 public holidays and an additional 30 annual days holiday. Training to improve efficiency and provide strength for future career are of course included. SSC Space Netherlands contributes 15,4% of pensionable salary to a company pension scheme and employees can optionally make additional contributions. To be considered for this Position Prior to 2026-08-21, please apply via our Job Application form. If not directly interested, feel free to share this Job Vacancy with your friends! Outro SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space. With local presence on all continents and about 750 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions. We help Earth benefit from space. Learn more at sscspace.com
